title: Subgroups Matter for Robust Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model generalisation (AUC, worst-group accuracy) on unbiased test distributions where training-time spurious attributes (e.g., synthetic image colors, medical pacemakers, smiling faces) are explicitly decoupled from the target label.

Measuring classification performance disparities (accuracy gaps and worst-group accuracy) across sex or perceived gender subgroups using medical X-rays (CheXPert), facial images (CelebA), and toxicity text classification (Civil_comments).

Evaluating toxicity prediction models on the Civil_comments text dataset by measuring performance disparities across subpopulation groups defined by mentions of specific religious identities (e.g., Christianity).
